mapper.select: SELECT m.*, e.name AS equipment_name FROM equipment_maintenance m LEFT JOIN equipment e ON m.equipment_id = e.id WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_maintenance (maintenance_no, title, equipment_id, maintenance_time, content, personnel, equipment_condition, images, remark) VALUES (#{maintenanceNo}, #{title}, #{equipmentId}, #{maintenanceTime}, #{content}, #{personnel}, #{equipmentCondition}, #{images}, #{remark})
